# SPDX-License-Identifier: LicenseRef-zkasuran-SAND-1.0
version: '1'
kind: miner
id: 0
slug: truth-finance-reserve
protocol: generic
name: Finance reference 77
description: 'SPDX-License-Identifier: LicenseRef-zkasuran-SAND-1.0. Own observation
  of the WBTC PoR oracle attestation on Ethereum mainnet at a finalized block. BTC
  reserves in zero-decimal micro-BTC. No liability completeness or bank assurance.'
base_url: https://telegraph-s2-hashprice.margyn.workers.dev
auth:
  type: none
endpoints:
- path: /truth/v2/finance-reserve
  external_path: /truth/v2/finance-reserve
  method: GET
  description: Own observation of the WBTC PoR oracle attestation on Ethereum mainnet
    at a finalized block. BTC reserves in zero-decimal micro-BTC. No liability completeness
    or bank assurance.
  intents:
  - ASSET_RESERVE_ATTESTATION_GENERAL
  params:
    query:
      required:
      - name: asset
        type: string
        intents:
        - '*'
        description: 'The tokenized asset: its symbol or contract address'
semantics:
  supported_intents:
  - ASSET_RESERVE_ATTESTATION_GENERAL
intent_mapping:
  ASSET_RESERVE_ATTESTATION_GENERAL:
    endpoint: /truth/v2/finance-reserve
    input:
      asset:
        from: asset
    output:
      attested_reserve:
        path: attested_reserve
        unit: micro-units of the underlying asset
